title: 916 Kunjoottan
overview: A man with a small frame but a massive presence leads a double life as a beloved villager and a sharp city tycoon. As love and secrets collide, he must prove that true worth comes from the mind, not the size..

songs.title: Kannodu Kannil (From "916 Kunjoottan") (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)
songs.singers: Anand Madhusoodanan, Madhu Balakrishnan, Narayani Gopan
